systems.name: 8.1 Titan Location & Excavation State
systems.notes: Buried titans are placed via world seed using TitanManager. Excavation is a multi‑session co‑op puzzle with hazard triggers. Requires the Ancient Goblin Lexicon from the Chieftain's quests (Phase 7) to locate. Each titan is a massive structure covered by blocks that must be carefully removed.

tasks.text: TitanManager places buried structures via seed
tasks.notes: Uses world seed for deterministic placement; multiple titans across biomes.

tasks.text: Model segments covered by blocks; excavation reveals
tasks.notes: Titan model split into parts (head, torso, limbs); digging away cover blocks exposes them.

tasks.text: Hazard triggers during digging (fuel pipe, collapse)
tasks.notes: Disturbing certain blocks triggers events from Phase 2 hazard system. Co‑op: one scans with Lexicon while other braces.

systems.name: 8.2 Restoration at Camp
systems.notes: After excavation, the titan can be claimed (requires Lexicon). Restoration happens at Tub's forge: each component (limbs, boiler, drill‑arm, cockpit) is a separate resource‑intensive project. The hangar appears as a camp expansion, visually showing progress.

tasks.text: Claim titan via Lexicon after excavation
Spend resources at Tub's forge per component
tasks.notes: Titan Bone, Core Crystals, Boiler Glands — rare materials from excavation and other phases.

tasks.text: Visual: repaired parts on hangar skeleton
tasks.notes: Gradual assembly; each completed part appears on the titan frame.

systems.name: 8.3 Two-Player Vehicle Control
systems.notes: The restored titan is a two‑player vehicle: Pilot (movement, colossal drill) and Engineer (boiler, repairs, special abilities). Both roles must be seated. Host authoritatively destroys blocks in a large area — clients see synchronized terrain changes. Input mapping must work for both keyboard and controller per role.

tasks.notes: Direct control; drill destroys 5×5 area per swing.
Manages fuel/steam pressure; can activate speed boost or horn.
Use existing gamepad.js; split controls clearly.

tasks.text: Host authoritatively destroys blocks in large area
tasks.notes: Block removal batch‑synced via message; clients update chunks accordingly.

systems.name: 8.4 Endgame Biome Access
systems.notes: Vaults of the Forgotten Sun are sealed by unbreakable barriers that only a titan drill can destroy. This provides the ultimate exploration goal — no boss fight, just pure digging freedom.

tasks.text: Titan-drill-only breakable barriers to Vaults of the Forgotten Sun
tasks.notes: Barrier blocks check for titan drill flag; normal drills do nothing.
